CURRENT SCENE:
他的妈妈不是不喜欢他们的城市，而是想孟子有很好的教育。他们搬家到有很多学校的城市。他们从早到晚走路，孟子一直抱怨。

ITEMS:

[I136] 而是想【^】孟子有很好的教育   correction: ∅ → 让   strength: error
  checker's note: 想 needs 让 before another subject and verb
  rule card (modal_and_control_verb_complements, Grammar): 想 must be followed by a verb phrase, not a noun; use 想让 + person + V. when you mean “want someone to do something.” 叫/让 + V. expresses an action someone is told or made to do, so do not add 了.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: 想 needs a following action (想 + V.); use 想让 + <person> + <V.> if the person is meant to do the action.  Her terms: 想 + V., 叫/让 is a modal verb, no了
  her past correction: 孟母一直想[+让]她的孩子受到良好的教育 — her note: 想 + V., cannot be followed by N.
  her past correction: 教育做完以后[+，]孟子考虑
  her past correction: [+孟子]练习写文字 — her note: miss a Subj.

[I137] 而是想孟子【有】很好的教育   correction: 有 → 接受   strength: error
  checker's note: one normally 接受 good education
  rule card (haide_harmful_result, Vocabulary): Use 害得 + N/sb. + harmful result (or a harmful clause). The result must be genuinely harmful: neutral events such as 搬家 or 玩儿, and mild feelings such as 不高兴, do not fit after 害得.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: after 害得 + <person/noun>, use a genuinely harmful result; <neutral or mild result> is not harmful enough.  Her terms: 害得 + N/sb. + Harmful result, 害得+Sb.+V., 害得 + clause (harmful result)
  her past correction: 害得对孟子[有→受到了]不好的影响 — her note: 害得+Sb.+V.
  her past correction: 孟母一直觉得[受到→接受]教育很重要
  her past correction: 教育做完以后[+，]孟子考虑

[I138] 他们搬【家】到有很多学校的城市   correction: 家 → (delete)   strength: suggestion
  rule card (zero_redundant_pronoun, Coherence: reference): When the same person or thing is already clear in the same clause or close continuation, delete the repeated subject or possessive: use zero form. In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <subject/possessive> is already clear, so delete it; Chinese uses zero form here.  Her terms: redundant, too many他, Subj.不是……而是……, Subj. before “不是……而是……”
  her past correction: [-他们]搬家每次学到了比较多
  her past correction: 他们搬到[+了]城市 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: [-他们]住离一个学校很近

[I139] 他们搬家到【^】有很多学校的城市   correction: ∅ → 了   strength: suggestion
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: 他们搬到[+了]城市 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: [-他们]搬家每次学到了比较多
  her past correction: [+所以]他们常常搬家 — her note: 无聊？add所以

[I140] 【他难怪】抱怨   correction: 他难怪 → 难怪他   strength: error
  checker's note: 难怪 should come before the subject
  rule card (incorrect_story_information, Content): Use the story’s established facts when retelling it. Do not add or change people, places, actions, objects, identities, or causes; otherwise it is wrong information.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: this changes a story fact; the story says <fact>.  Her terms: wrong information, problematic in coherence
  her past correction: ⟦难怪我们没有钱⟧ — her note: wrong information, 搬家因为孟母觉得it is not good to imitate how to buy and sell
  her past correction: 人类[就多么奇怪呢→就是这么奇怪呢]
  her past correction: 可是孟子的妈妈[有别的看法→就抱怨] — her note: wrong conjunctions, 他只要跟朋友玩儿 ; 只要……就as long as

items.explanation: 想 needs a following action (想 + V.). Use 想让 + person + V. when you mean “want someone to do something.”
For education, it is more natural to say 接受教育, not 有教育.
It would be more natural to delete 家 here. 搬到 already expresses moving to the new city.
The move is completed in the story, so use 了completed: 搬到了.
难怪 comes before the subject: 难怪他抱怨.
